accepted_alternatives: maximum displacement from the rest position; intensity is proportional to amplitude squared

parts.answer: When amplitude doubles, intensity becomes four times as large, for example 2.0 to 4.0 mm gives 10 to 40 W m⁻². Thus I/A² is constant and I ∝ A².
accepted_alternatives: Any valid pairwise square-ratio demonstration from the data.
